methods.name: Embedded multichannel spectral–topographic feature fusion model
methods.summary: An optimized DeepLab V3+ model that integrates optical imagery with topographic features (DEM, slope, aspect). It uses an embedded pre-convolution operation to fuse multichannel inputs into a 3-channel format, followed by a ResNet backbone and an atrous spatial pyramid pooling (ASPP) encoder-decoder structure for semantic segmentation.
methods.source: Xiangxiang Zheng, Lingyi Han, Guojin He, Ning Wang, Guizhou Wang, and Lei Feng
methods.verbatim: this study proposes an embedded multichannel spectral–topographic feature fusion coseismic landslide extraction model based on DeepLab V3+.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or made available, and the custom code for the proposed model lacks a repository or persistent link.
